summary: Join our Advanced Selection, Interviewing & Recruitment Skills Course to refine your hiring strategies and improve your recruitment outcomes.
lede: Advanced recruitment and interviewing training helps hiring professionals structure candidate selection around role requirements. For HR specialists, managers and team leaders involved in hiring, it covers writing job descriptions, screening applications and conducting competency-based and behavioral interviews. Participants also learn to reduce bias, assess candidates consistently and coordinate hiring decisions and onboarding.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for hiring and recruitment, whether directly or indirectly.
modules: Recruitment for Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI)
